details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Denial of service via quadratic complexity in
     storeAtts(), which scanned elementType->defaultAtts linearly to
     determine the CDATA status of every non-normalized attribute
     (libexpat through 2.8.3)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66046.patch: store the index of the first
       default attribute declaration in the per-element defaultAttsNames
       hash table and use a hash lookup instead of the linear scan in
       expat/lib/xmlparse.c; includes upstream's follow-up for dtdCopy()
       so that external entity parsers do not read past the hash table
       entries, and carries upstream's regression test into
       expat/tests/runtests.c
     - CVE-2026-66046
   * SECURITY UPDATE: XML injection via malformed UTF-16 input: a high
     surrogate not followed by a low surrogate is accepted and consumes
     the following code unit, hiding markup characters from the parser
     (libexpat through 2.8.4)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-93990.patch: reject a UTF-16 high
       surrogate whose second code unit is not a low surrogate by
       defining IS_INVALID_CHAR (and isInvalid4 for XML_MIN_SIZE) for the
       little2_/big2_ encodings in expat/lib/xmltok.c and dropping the
       permissive fallback from expat/lib/xmltok_impl.c; also carries
       upstream's regression test into expat/tests/runtests.c
     - CVE-2026-93990
